put_request.title: As a user I can publish a feature
put_request.description: Publish gathers the feature + its published stage artifacts and PUTs them with base_version CAS.
acceptance_criteria: Given a completed feature, When I click Publish, Then a PUT /records/feature is sent with base_version.
Given a 409 conflict, When publish returns, Then Genesis surfaces notify-then-apply.
Given unicode content (東京 🚀), When published, Then it round-trips byte-for-byte.
